The user wants to inspect whether the UR5e arm is ready. This requires checking controller activation and a fresh joint sample. According to the instructions, I need to first select a skill before any other tool call. The public authorized skill catalogue shows "ur5e.inspect_readiness" which is a read-only inspection skill that checks:
- controllers: ["trajectory_controller_active", "joint_state_broadcaster_active"]
- joint_state: ["joint_sample_fresh"]

This matches the user's request to inspect readiness without changing controllers. I should select this skill first.
